cards.title: Density-matrix Schmidt bath
cards.latex: gamma_EI = U s V^dagger; B_DM = columns(U) with retained singular values

checks.reason: The off-diagonal 1-RDM SVD construction is stated explicitly.
The independent Slater-determinant test reconstructs the impurity 1-RDM to below 1e-12.

cards.numerical_form: SVD the environment-impurity block, retain nonzero singular vectors, and orthonormalize against impurity orbitals.
open_questions: The production singular-value threshold is not printed.

cards.title: Green-function bath
cards.latex: Im g_EI(omega_n) = U_n s_n V_n^dagger; B_GF = orthogonalized union of retained U_n

checks.reason: The real-frequency SVD construction and uniform grid are stated.
The selected union is orthonormal and disjoint from impurity and B_DM to below 1e-12.

cards.numerical_form: Evaluate the mean-field resolvent on a real-frequency grid, concatenate weighted environment singular vectors, and rank-reveal by SVD.
open_questions: Frequency range, spacing, broadening, and threshold are not printed.

cards.title: Cluster-specific natural-orbital bath
cards.latex: D_env^(2) = dMP2 environment 1-RDM; D_env^(2) U = U n; B_NO = selected columns(U)

checks.reason: The dMP2 natural-orbital idea and low virtual augmentation are stated, but the complete selection algorithm is not.
Independent tests clip only roundoff outside [0,1] and verify the selected orbitals are orthonormal.

cards.numerical_form: Diagonalize a projected dMP2 correlated 1-RDM, select occupied and virtual natural orbitals by explicit thresholds, and optionally append the lowest canonical virtuals.
open_questions: Natural-occupation thresholds, dMP2 partition details, and number of low virtuals are not printed.

cards.title: Projected interacting Hamiltonian and HF double-counting removal
cards.latex: H_emb = sum_ij Ftilde_ij a_i^dagger a_j + 1/2 sum_ijkl (ij|kl) a_i^dagger a_k^dagger a_l a_j; Ftilde_ij = Femb_ij - sum_kl gammaemb_kl[(ij|lk)-1/2(ik|lj)]

checks.reason: Both equations and the projection Femb=Rdagger Ffull R are printed.
Re-adding the projected Hartree-Fock contraction recovers Femb to 1.4e-17 in the attested validation.

cards.numerical_form: Transform one- and two-electron tensors with R and subtract the embedded Hartree-Fock self-energy exactly once.

cards.title: Embedded-to-full self-energy assembly

checks.reason: Independent unitary-rotation tests recover the embedded self-energy to below 1e-11.

cards.numerical_form: Rotate each impurity-centred self-energy, combine overlapping blocks with explicit democratic weights, and Fourier transform lattice translations to momentum.
open_questions: The exact democratic weighting convention is not printed in the main article.

cards.title: GW plus ibDET self-energy replacement

checks.reason: The replacement equation is printed explicitly.
The independent limiting-case test reduces to full-system GW exactly.

cards.numerical_form: Combine three self-energy tensors only after aligning basis, frequency grid, chemical potential, and static-reference conventions.

cards.title: Dyson spectral observables

source_refs.value: Main Figs. 2-4 and standard Dyson relation

checks.reason: The figure captions and text define DOS, spectral maps, gaps, and occupied bandwidths as the observables.
The attested Lehmann spectrum satisfies the integrated spectral-weight sum rule to 0.45 percent.
The noninteracting limit gives a self-energy below 2e-11 and identical Lehmann and Dyson spectra.

cards.numerical_form: Solve Dyson's equation on declared k and frequency grids, integrate for DOS, and extract direct or indirect gaps and occupied bandwidths.
open_questions: Production frequency grids and broadenings are not printed.

cards.title: Local-only counterfactual and real-space nonlocal range

checks.reason: The Na analysis explicitly defines the local-only correction and the real-space 3s-3s shell observable.
The local counterfactual test preserves same-atom blocks and zeros every interatomic block exactly.
The finite-grid transform implementation is covered by direct algebraic tests.

cards.numerical_form: Zero all interatomic correction blocks for the local counterfactual; shell-average the full real-space 3s-3s correction for Fig. 4(c).
open_questions: The paper does not print point-level shell values.
